decision: Model Circle USDC and XRP as distinct assets in a shared Deribit collateral framework; do not infer actual CFM use or new XRP spot demand.
rules: USDC and XRP are both listed as full Deribit cross-collateral currencies; neither is an offset currency in the September 28 table.
USDC has no stated X:PM/X:SM haircut; XRP has no stated X:PM haircut and 15% X:SM haircut.
Track Deribit account margin mode because X:PM and X:SM haircuts differ.
USDC's pre-GENIUS payment-stablecoin match is a sourced regulatory inference from issuer licensing, reserve composition and monthly attestations, not an asset-specific CFTC determination.
RLUSD is a candidate for the pre-GENIUS payment-stablecoin definition, but reserve-fund look-through is required and it is not listed in the current Deribit cross-collateral table.
Treat net stablecoin supply change as an issuer-level circulation feature, not direct capital flow into or out of XRP or Deribit.
Do not admit collateral-utility features until CFM account enablement and actual balances are verified.
